name: Anti-Magic Zone
description: Places an Anti-Magic Zone for 6 sec, reducing the magic damage taken by party or raid members by 15%.

name: Death Pact
description: Create a death pact that heals you for 50% of your maximum health, but absorbs incoming healing equal to 30% of your max health for 15 sec.

name: Icebound Fortitude
description: Your blood freezes, granting immunity to Stun effects and reducing all damage you take by 30% for 8 sec.

name: Raise Dead
description: Raises a ghoul to fight by your side.  You can have a maximum of one ghoul at a time. Lasts 1 min.

name: Army of the Dead
description: Summons a legion of 8 empowered Lesser Ghouls that last for 15 sec to swarm your enemies.\n\nGenerates 40 Runic Power.

name: Blinding Sleet
description: Targets in a cone in front of you are blinded, causing them to wander disoriented for 5 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.\n\nWhen Blinding Sleet ends, enemies are slowed by 50% for 6 sec.

name: Dark Transformation
description: Corrupt and evolve your Ghoul into a Monstrosity, greatly empowering its abilities for 15 sec.\n\nDeath Coil and Epidemic extends the duration of this effect by 1.0 sec.

name: Mind Freeze
description: Smash the target's mind with cold, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec.

name: Soul Reaper
description:
Rupture the soul of your enemy, dealing 156 Shadowfrost damage and causing the foe to take 20% increased damage from your diseases and minions for 8 sec.

Only usable on enemies below 35% maximum health.

Consumes up to 2 available charges to cast Putrefy.

name: Control Undead
description: Dominates the target undead creature up to level 71, forcing it to do your bidding for 5 min.

name: Death Strike
description: Focuses dark power into a strike that deals 54 Physical damage and heals you for 20.00% of all damage taken in the last 5 sec, minimum 7.0% of maximum health.

name: Outbreak
description:
Inflicts the target with Dread Plague and Virulent Plague.

Dread Plague
A malicious plague that deals 153 Shadow damage over 24 sec. Explodes for 64 Shadow damage to nearby enemies and infects one when the host dies. Can only be applied to 1 host at a time.

Virulent Plague
An infectious plague that spreads to all nearby enemies, dealing 70 Shadow damage over 24 sec.

name: Putrefy
description: Summon a Lesser Ghoul to strike the enemy for 82 Shadow damage and have them explode for 42 Shadow damage to nearby enemies.

name: Scourge Strike
description: An unholy strike that deals 46 Shadow damage and causing your plagues on the target to erupt, dealing their damage an additional time at 35% effectiveness.\n\nApplies Virulent Plague or spreads it to a nearby enemy.

name: Wraith Walk
description: Embrace the power of the Shadowlands, removing all root effects and increasing your movement speed by 70% for 4 sec. Taking any action cancels the effect.\n\nWhile active, your movement speed cannot be reduced below 170%.

name: Asphyxiate
description: Lifts the enemy target off the ground, crushing their throat with dark energy and stunning them for 5 sec.

name: Raise Ally
description: Pours dark energy into a dead target, reuniting spirit and body to allow the target to reenter battle with 60% health and at least 20% mana.

name: Sindragosa's Fury
description: Summons Sindragosa, who breathes frost on all enemies within 40 yd in front of you, dealing 146 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 50% for 10 sec.

name: Lichborne
description: Draw upon unholy energy to become Undead for 10 sec, increasing Leech by 6% and making you immune to Charm, Fear, and Sleep.

name: Apocalypse
description: Strikes the enemy, dealing 3 Physical damage and bursting up to 6 Festering Wounds on the target, summoning a member of your Army of the Dead for 20 sec for each burst Festering Wound.

name: Anti-Magic Shell
description: Surrounds you in an Anti-Magic Shell for 5 sec, absorbing up to 9,165 magic damage and preventing application of harmful magical effects. Damage absorbed generates Runic Power.

name: Death Gate
description: Opens a gate which you can use to return to Ebon Hold.\n\nUsing a Death Gate while in Ebon Hold will return you back to near your departure point.

name: Consumption
description: Strikes all enemies in front of you with a hungering attack that deals 87 Physical damage and heals you for 100% of that damage.

name: Corpse Exploder
description: Cause a target corpse to explode in a shower of gore. Does not affect mechanical or elemental corpses.

name: Dark Command
description: Command the target to attack you, and increases the threat you generate against them by 800% for 6 sec.

name: Death Grip
description: Harnesses the energy that surrounds and binds all matter, drawing the target toward you.

name: Death's Advance
description: For 10 sec, your movement speed is increased by 35%, you cannot be slowed below 100% of normal speed, and you are immune to forced movement effects and knockbacks.\n\nPassive: You cannot be slowed below 70% of normal speed.

name: Blood Plague
description: A shadowy disease that drains 93 health from the target over 24 sec.

name: Chains of Ice
description: Shackles the target with frozen chains, reducing movement speed by 70% for 8 sec.

name: Death Coil
description: Fires a blast of unholy energy at the target, causing 74 Shadow damage to an enemy or healing an Undead ally for 165 health.\n\nExtends the duration of Dread Plague and Virulent Plague by 1.5 sec.

name: Death and Decay
description: Corrupts the ground targeted by the Death Knight, causing Shadow damage every sec that targets remain in the area for 10 sec.

name: Epidemic
description: Causes each of your Virulent Plagues to flare up, dealing 22 Shadow damage to the infected enemy and 8 Shadow damage to foes nearby.\n\nExtends the duration of Dread Plague and Virulent Plague by 1.5 sec.

name: Festering Strike
description:
Slash the enemy for 70 Physical damage and corrupt your weapon with blight, causing your next 2-3 Scourge Strikes to summon a Lesser Ghoul.

Lesser Ghoul
A mindless servant of the Scourge, raised to obey its master's commands for 6 sec.

name: Frost Breath
description: Summons Sindragosa, who breathes frost on all enemies within 40 yd in front of you, dealing 148 Frost damage and slowing movement speed by 50% for 10 sec.

name: Frost Fever
description: A disease that deals 59 Frost damage over 24 sec and has a chance to grant the Death Knight 4 Runic Power each time it deals damage.

name: Path of Frost
description: Activates a freezing aura for 10 min that creates ice beneath your feet, allowing party or raid members within 50 yards to walk on water.\n\nUsable while mounted, but being attacked or damaged will cancel the effect.

name: Rune Strike
description: Strike the target for 21 Physical damage. This attack cannot be dodged, blocked, or parried.

name: Rune of Razorice
description: Engrave your weapon with a rune that causes ${$max(($<coeff>*$AP),1)}% extra weapon damage as Frost damage and increases enemies' vulnerability to your Frost attacks by $51714s1%, stacking up to $51714u times. $?a332944[][\n\nModifying your rune requires a Runeforge in Ebon Hold.]

name: Rune of Sanguination
description: Engrave your weapon with a rune that causes your Death Strike to deal increased damage based on the target's missing health. When you fall below $326801s1% health, you heal for ${$326808s1*$326808d}% of your maximum health over $326808d. \n\nModifying your rune requires a Runeforge in Ebon Hold.

name: Rune of Spellwarding
description: Engrave your weapon with a rune that deflects $326864s2% of all spell damage and taking magic damage has a chance to create a shield that absorbs magic damage equal to $s2% of your maximum health. When an enemy damages the shield, their cast speed is reduced by $326868s1% for $326868d. \n\nModifying your rune requires a Runeforge in Ebon Hold.

name: Rune of Unending Thirst
description: Engrave your weapon with a rune that increases your movement speed by $326982s2%. Additionally, when you kill an enemy that yields experience or honor you heal for $326984s2% of your maximum health and gain $326984s1% Haste and movement speed.\n\nModifying your rune requires a Runeforge in Ebon Hold.

name: Rune of the Apocalypse
description: Engrave your weapon with a rune that gives your ghoul's attacks a chance to apply one of the following debuffs to the target, Death: Healing Reduction, War: Increases damage taken from the Death Knight, Famine: Reduces damage dealt to the Death Knight, Pestilence: Slows the target and deals damage over time. \n\nModifying your rune requires a Runeforge in Ebon Hold.

name: Rune of the Fallen Crusader
description: Engrave your weapon with a rune that has a chance to heal you for $53365s2% of your maximum health and increase total Strength by $53365s1% for $53365d.  \n\nModifying your rune requires a Runeforge in Ebon Hold.

name: Rune of the Stoneskin Gargoyle
description: Engrave your weapon with a rune that increases Armor by $62157s1% and all stats by $62157s2%.\n\nModifying your rune requires a Runeforge in Ebon Hold.

name: Runeforging
description: Allows the Death Knight to emblazon their weapon with runes.

name: Single-Button Assistant
description: Casts damaging abilities for use in combat, rotating through them based on priority.\n\nThe global cooldown of abilities used through the Single-Button Assistant is 25% longer.

name: Strangulate
description: Shadowy tendrils constrict an enemy's throat, silencing them for 4 sec.

name: Dark Simulacrum
description: Places a dark ward on an enemy player that persists for 12 sec, triggering when the enemy next spends mana on a spell, and allowing the Death Knight to unleash an exact duplicate of that spell.

name: Bloodforged Armor
description: Death Strike reduces all Physical damage taken by 25% for 4 sec.

name: Doomburst
description: Sudden Doom also causes your next Death Coil to deal the damage of your plagues an additional time at 25% effectiveness and reduce the target's movement speed by 45% for 3 sec.

name: Life and Death
description: When the target afflicted with your Dread Plague is healed, you are also healed for 10% of the amount.\n\nAdditionally, Dread Plague deals 200% of its remaining damage to the target when dispelled.

name: Necrotic Wounds
description: Putrefy applies a Necrotic Wound to the enemy when it deals damage, absorbing 8% of all healing received for 15 sec.\n\nMax 3 stacks. Adding a stack does not refresh the duration.

name: Rot and Wither
description: Your Death and Decay rots enemies each time it deals damage, absorbing healing equal to 100% of damage dealt.

name: Spellwarden
description: Anti-Magic Shell is now usable on allies and its cooldown is reduced by 10 sec.

name: Stitchmaster
description: When a Lesser Ghoul dies, you gather the remains to heal for 2% of its maximum health.\n\nDeath Strike sacrifices all Lesser Ghouls under your command.

name: Zombify
description: Reanimates a nearby corpse, summoning a zombie for 20 sec that slowly moves towards your target. \n\nIf your zombie reaches its target, it explodes after 3.0 sec. The explosion stuns all enemies within 8 yards for 3 sec and deals 10% of their health in Shadow damage.

name: A Feast of Souls
description: While you have 2 or more Horsemen aiding you, your  increased damage.

name: All Will Serve
description:
Raise Dead summons an additional skeletal archer at your command that shoots Blighted Arrows.

Blighted Arrow
An unholy arrow that deals 11 Shadow damage. When consuming Sudden Doom, your Death Coil commands your archer to fire an additional Blighted Arrow at 80% effectiveness. Epidemic will instead cause Blighted Arrow to ricochet and hit up to 5 additional targets.

name: Ancient Power
description: Spending Runic Power increases your Strength by 0.50% for 20 sec.\n\nMultiple applications may overlap.

name: Anti-Magic Barrier
description: Reduces the cooldown of Anti-Magic Shell by 20 sec and increases its duration and amount absorbed by 40%.

name: Apocalypse Now
description: Army of the Dead and Frostwyrm's Fury call upon all 4 Horsemen to aid you for 20 sec.

name: Assimilation
description: The cooldown of Anti-Magic Zone is reduced by 60 sec and its duration is increased by 2 sec.

name: Blightburst
description: The explosion effect of Putrefy extends the duration of your plagues by 4.5 sec and deals 35% of the damage they would deal over that time instantly.\n\nPutrefy now applies your plagues to unaffected targets.

name: Blightfall
description:
Dark Transformation grants access to Blightfall.

Blightfall
Consume 100% of your plagues around you and deal 100% of their remaining damage instantly.

Grants 1 charge of Putrefy.

name: Blood Bond
description: While you are below 50% health, your Ghoul sacrifices 4% of its maximum health to heal you for 1% of your maximum health every sec.

name: Blood Draw
description: When you fall below 30% health you drain 42 health from nearby enemies, the damage you take is reduced by 10% and your Death Strike cost is reduced by 10 for 8 sec.\n\nCan only occur every 2 min.

name: Blood Scent
description: Increases Leech by 3%.

name: Blood-Soaked Ground
description: While you are within your Death and Decay, your physical damage taken is reduced by 5% and your chance to gain Vampiric Strike is increased by 5%.

name: Bloody Fortitude
description: Icebound Fortitude reduces all damage you take by up to an additional 20% based on your missing health.\n\nKilling an enemy that yields experience or honor reduces the cooldown of Icebound Fortitude by 3 sec.

name: Brittle
description: Your diseases have a chance to weaken your enemy causing your attacks against them to deal 6% increased damage for 5 sec.

name: Clawing Shadows
description: Shadows guide your strikes, increasing the damage of your Scourge Strike by 25%, and causing it to grant you Clawing Shadows up to 4 times.\n\nFor each stack of Clawing Shadows, your Scourge Strike chains to an additional enemy. Each subsequent chain deals 20% reduced damage.

name: Cleaving Strikes
description: $?a137006[Frostscythe deals $s3% increased damage during Remorseless Winter.][]$?a137008[Heart Strike hits up to $s1][]$?a137007[Scourge Strike and Festering Strike deal $s4% increased damage.][]$?a137008[ additional enemies while you remain in Death and Decay.\n\nWhen leaving your Death and Decay you retain its bonus effects for ${$s2/1000} sec.][]

name: Coil of Devastation
description: Death Coil deals 10% increased damage and causes the target to take an additional 30% of the direct damage dealt over 4 sec.

name: Coldthirst
description: Successfully interrupting an enemy with Mind Freeze grants 10 Runic Power and reduces its cooldown by 3 sec.

name: Commander of the Dead
description: Dark Transformation empowers your Gargoyle, Abomination, Magus and Lesser Ghouls for 30 sec, increasing their damage by 25%.\n\nThe duration of Lesser Ghouls are increased by 0% of your Mastery.

name: Cycle of Death
description: Putrefy reduces the cooldown of Death and Decay by 1.0 sec.\n\nDeath and Decay reduces the cooldown of Putrefy by 0.3 sec for each enemy it damages, up to 3.0 sec.

name: Death Charge
description: Call upon your Death Charger to break free of movement impairment effects.\n\nFor 10 sec, while upon your Death Charger your movement speed is increased by 100%, you cannot be slowed below 100% of normal speed, and you are immune to forced movement effects and knockbacks.

name: Death Defiance
description: The cooldown of Death Pact is reduced by 30 sec, and you receive 50% increased healing while its healing absorb is active.

name: Death Notes
description: Raise Ally costs 30 less Runic Power.

name: Death's Echo
description: Death's Advance, Death and Decay, and Death Grip have 1 additional charge.

name: Death's Reach
description: Increases the range of Death Grip by 10 yds.\n\nKilling an enemy that yields experience or honor resets the cooldown of Death Grip.

name: Desecrate
description: Death and Decay deals its damage 100% faster.

name: Doomed Bidding
description: Consuming Sudden Doom summons forth a Lesser Ghoul to assist you for 6 sec.

name: Ebon Fever
description: Plagues deal 15% more damage over time in 75% of their duration.

name: Enfeeble
description: Your ghoul's attacks have a chance to apply Enfeeble, reducing the enemies movement speed by 30% and the damage they deal to you by 12% for 6 sec.

name: Festering Scythe
description:
Festering Strike now follows up with a Festering Scythe that costs no Runes.

Festering Scythe
Slashes through all enemies within 14 yds in front of you, dealing 35 Shadow damage and hastening all of your plagues on targets hit to deal damage 35% faster for 25 sec.

name: Forbidden Knowledge
description:
Army of the Dead siphons the power of the fallen, transforming Death Coil and Epidemic into Necrotic Coil and Graveyard for 30 sec.

Necrotic Coil
Unleash a vortex of necrotic energy and bone, dealing 77 Shadowstrike damage up to 3 foes and 24 Shadow damage to all pierced enemies.

Graveyard
The dead erupt beneath all foes with Virulent Plague, dealing 33 Shadow damage and 13 Shadow damage to enemies nearby.

name: Foul Infections
description: Your diseases deal 10% more damage and have a 5% increased chance to critically strike.

name: Frenzied Bloodthirst
description: Essence of the Blood Queen stacks 2 additional times and increases the damage of your Death Coil and Death Strike by 5%, and Epidemic by 5% per stack.

name: Fury of the Horsemen
description: Every 50 Runic Power you spend extends the duration of the Horsemen's aid in combat by 1 sec, up to 5 sec.

name: Ghoulish Frenzy
description: Dark Transformation increases the attack speed and damage of you and your Monstrosity by 5% for 15 sec.

name: Gift of the San'layn
description: While Dark Transformation is active you gain Gift of the San'layn.\n\nGift of the San'layn increases the effectiveness of your Essence of the Blood Queen by 200%, and Vampiric Strike replaces your Scourge Strike for the duration.

name: Gloom Ward
description: Absorbs are 15% more effective on you.

name: Grave Mastery
description: Critical strike damage of your minions is increased by 15%

name: Grip of the Dead
description: Death and Decay reduces the movement speed of enemies within its area by 90%, decaying by 10% every sec.

name: Harbinger of Doom
description: Sudden Doom triggers 30% more often and can accumulate up to 2 charges.\n\nSummoning a Lesser Ghoul with Scourge Strike reduces the cooldown of Putrefy by 2.5 sec.

name: Horsemen's Aid
description: While at your aid, the Horsemen will occasionally cast Anti-Magic Shell on you and themselves at 80% effectiveness.\n\nYou may only benefit from this effect every 45 sec.

name: Hungering Thirst
description: The damage of your diseases and Death Coil are increased by 5%.

name: Ice Prison
description: Chains of Ice now also roots enemies for 4 sec but its cooldown is increased to 12 sec.

name: Icy Talons
description: Your Runic Power spending abilities increase your melee attack speed by 6% for 10 sec, stacking up to 3 times.

name: Improved Death Strike
description: Death Strike's cost is reduced by 10, and its healing is increased by 60%.

name: Incite Terror
description: Vampiric Strike and Scourge Strike cause your targets to take 1% increased Shadow damage, up to 5% for 15 sec.\n\nVampiric Strike benefits from Incite Terror at 400% effectiveness.

name: Inevitable
description: Your plagues deal up to 30% increased damage based on the target's missing health.

name: Infected Claws
description: The infected claws of your ghouls have a chance to sicken the foe, dealing 7 Shadow damage over 12 sec. When reapplied, any remaining damage is added to the new effect.

name: Infliction of Sorrow
description: When Vampiric Strike damages an enemy affected by your plagues, it extends the duration of the plagues by 3.0 sec, and deals 10% of the remaining damage to the enemy.

name: Insidious Chill
description: Your auto-attacks reduce the target's auto-attack speed by 5% for 30 sec, stacking up to 4 times.

name: Let Terror Reign
description: Casting Death Coil or Epidemic orders Whitemane to cast her Death Coil or Epidemic alongside you at 125% effectiveness.

name: Magus of the Dead
description: Dark Transformation and Army of the Dead summon a Magus of the Dead who hurls Frostbolts and Shadow Bolts at your foes for 15 sec.

name: March of Darkness
description: Death's Advance grants an additional 25% movement speed over the first 3 sec.

name: Mawsworn Menace
description: Scourge Strike deals 15% increased damage and the cooldown of your Death and Decay is reduced by 5 sec.

name: Menacing Magus
description: Your Magus of the Dead Shadow Bolt now fires a volley of Shadow Bolts at up to 8 nearby enemies.

name: Mograine's Might
description: Your damage is increased by 5% and you gain  while inside Mograine's Death and Decay.

name: Morbidity
description: Diseased enemies take 1% increased damage from you per disease they are affected by.

name: Nazgrim's Conquest
description: If an enemy dies while Nazgrim is active, the strength of Apocalyptic Conquest is increased by 3%.\n\nAdditionally, each Rune you spend increase its value by 1%.

name: Necromancer's Cunning
description: When your Lesser Ghouls expire, they explode in viscera, dealing 15 Shadow damage to enemies nearby.

name: Newly Turned
description: Raise Ally revives players at full health and grants you and your ally an absorb shield equal to 20% of your maximum health.

name: Null Magic
description: Magic damage taken is reduced by 8% and the duration of harmful Magic effects against you are reduced by 35%.

name: On a Paler Horse
description: While outdoors you are able to mount your Acherus Deathcharger in combat.

name: Osmosis
description: Anti-Magic Shell increases healing received by 15%.

name: Outnumber
description:
Each Lesser Ghoul increases the damage of your permanent Ghoul by 10%, and Dark Transformation additionally empowers the Claw attacks of your Lesser Ghouls to Sweeping Claws.

Sweeping Claws
Rakes an enemy with deformed claws, dealing 24 Shadow damage to the target and 16 Shadow damage to nearby enemies.

name: Pact of the Apocalypse
description: When you take damage, 5% of the damage is redirected to each active horsemen.

name: Pact of the San'layn
description: You store 10% of all Shadow damage dealt into your Blood Beast to explode for additional damage when it expires.

name: Permafrost
description: Your auto attack damage grants you an absorb shield equal to 40% of the damage dealt.

name: Plague Mastery
description: Critical strike damage of your diseases is increased by 25%

name: Proliferating Chill
description: Chains of Ice affects 1 additional nearby enemy.

name: Putrid Echoes
description: Putrefy deals 20% increased damage, has 2 additional charges and consumes up to 2 available charges.

name: Raise Abomination
description: Army of the Dead now raises an Abomination for 30 sec to attack enemies while emitting a disease cloud, dealing 12 Plague damage to nearby enemies every 2 sec.

name: Reanimation
description: When you Putrefy a Lesser Ghoul, it has a 100% chance to reanimate as a Magus of the Dead who hurls Frostbolts and Shadow Bolts at your foes for 15 sec.\n\nMagus of the Dead Frostbolts and Shadow Bolts deal 25% increased damage.

name: Reaping
description: Scourge Strike, Festering Strike, and Death Coil deal 30% additional damage to enemies below 35% health.\n\nDark Transformation resets Soul Reaper's cooldown and allows it to be used on any target.

name: Ride or Die!
description: Dark Transformation summons forth Whitemane for 6 sec.

name: Rider's Champion
description:
Spending Runes has a chance to call forth the aid of a Horsemen for 10 sec.

Mograine
Casts Death and Decay at his location that follows his position and extends the duration of your diseases by 1.0 sec whenever it deals damage.

Whitemane
Casts Undeath on your target dealing 2 Shadowfrost damage per stack every 3 sec, for 24 sec. Each time Undeath deals damage it gains a stack. Cannot be refreshed.

Trollbane
Casts Chains of Ice on your target slowing their movement speed by 40% and increasing the damage they take from you by 5% for 8 sec.

Nazgrim
While Nazgrim is active you gain Apocalyptic Conquest, increasing your Strength by 5%.

name: Rune Mastery
description: Consuming a Rune has a chance to increase your Strength by 3% for 8 sec.

name: Runic Attenuation
description: Auto attacks have a chance to generate 3 Runic Power.

name: Runic Protection
description: Your chance to be critically struck is reduced by 3% and your Armor is increased by 6%.

name: Sanguine Scent
description: Your Death Coil and Death Strike have a 15% increased chance to trigger Vampiric Strike when damaging enemies below 35% health.

name: Scourging
description: Scourge Strike now causes your Plagues to erupt at 50% effectiveness.\n\nClawing Shadows can now stack 1 additional times.

name: Subduing Grasp
description: When you would pull an enemy, the damage they deal to you is reduced by 6% for 6 sec.

name: Sudden Doom
description: Dread Plague has a 35% chance to exhilarate you, making your next Death Coil or Epidemic cost 15 less Runic Power and deal 35% increased damage.

name: Summon Gargoyle
description: Army of the Dead now summons a Gargoyle into the battlefield to bombard your enemies for 25 sec.\n\nThe Gargoyle gains 1% increased damage for every 1 Runic Power you spend and always critically strikes.

name: Superstrain
description: Dread Plague deals damage to an additional nearby enemy at 75% effectiveness and has a chance to grant you 4 Runic Power.

name: Suppression
description: Damage taken from area of effect attacks reduced by 3%. When suffering a loss of control effect, this bonus is increased by an additional 6% for 6 sec.

name: The Blood is Life
description: Dark Transformation summons a Blood Beast to attack your enemy for 10 sec.\n\nEach time the Blood Beast attacks, it stores a portion of the damage dealt. When the Blood Beast dies, it explodes, dealing 25% of the damage accumulated to nearby enemies and healing the Death Knight for the same amount. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

name: Thrill of Blood
description: Essence of the Blood Queen additionally increases your Mastery by 1.0% per stack.\n\nBlood Plague deals 5% increased damage.

name: Transfusion
description: Vampiric Strike increases the damage of your Dancing Rune Weapons by 20% for 8 sec. \n\nMultiple applications may overlap.

name: Trollbane's Icy Fury
description: Scourge Strike shatters Trollbane's Chains of Ice when hit, dealing 36 Shadowfrost damage to nearby enemies, and slowing them by 40% for 4 sec. Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

name: Unholy Armaments
description: The abilities that Horsemen cast deal 5% increased damage..

name: Unholy Aura
description: Each Magus of the Dead under your command grants you 1.0% Haste.

name: Unholy Bond
description: Increases the effectiveness of your Runeforge effects by 20%.

name: Unholy Devotion
description: Putrefy causes your permanent Ghoul to go on an unholy frenzy, increasing its attack speed and energy regeneration by 25% for 12 sec.\n\nMultiple applications may overlap.

name: Unholy Endurance
description: Increases Lichborne duration by 2 sec and reduces the cooldown by 30 sec.

name: Unholy Momentum
description: Increases Haste by 2%.

name: Unyielding Will
description: Anti-Magic Shell now removes all harmful magical effects when activated, but its cooldown is increased by 20 sec.

name: Vampiric Aura
description: Your Leech is increased by 2%.\n\nWhile Lichborne is active, the Leech bonus of this effect is increased by 100%, and it affects 4 allies within 12 yds.

name: Vampiric Speed
description: Death's Advance and Wraith Walk movement speed bonuses are increased by 10%.\n\nActivating Death's Advance or Wraith Walk increases 4 nearby allies movement speed by 20% for 5 sec.

name: Vampiric Strike
description: Your Death Coil and Death Strike have a 25% chance to make your next Scourge Strike become Vampiric Strike.\n\nVampiric Strike heals you for 2% of your maximum health and grants you Essence of the Blood Queen, increasing your Haste by 1.0%, up to 5.0% for 20 sec.

name: Vestigial Shell
description: Casting Anti-Magic Shell grants 2 nearby allies a Lesser Anti-Magic Shell that Absorbs up to 148 magic damage and reduces the duration of harmful Magic effects against them by 50%.

name: Veteran of the Third War
description: Stamina increased by 20%.

name: Visceral Strength
description: When Sudden Doom is consumed, you gain 4% Strength for 5 sec.

name: Whitemane's Famine
description: When Scourge Strike damages an enemy affected by Undeath it gains 1 stack and infects another nearby enemy.

name: Will of the Necropolis
description: Damage taken below 30% Health is reduced by 20%.

name: Gnaw
description: Bite and tear at a target's limbs, dealing light damage and stunning for $91800d.$?s1233448[\n\n|CFFE55BB0Dark Transformation: Strike an enemy with a smashing attack, dealing $<monstrousblow> Physical damage and stunning for $91797d.|R][]

name: Dark Succor
description: When you kill an enemy that yields experience or honor, your next Death Strike within 20 sec is free and heals for an additional 10% of maximum health.

name: Runic Corruption
description: Each Runic Power you spend has a 2.0% chance to increase your Rune regeneration rate by 100% for 3 sec.
